spatial_reference: left/right refer to the fixed world-coordinate WA-01 dining placement zones, not camera-image directions or initial cup positions.
high_level_instruction: Start at the coffee machine with two identical prepared coffees. Add one sugar cube to either coffee, carry both coffees to the dining counter, and pick up the coffee cup you sugared.

add_sugar.label: add one sugar cube to a coffee cup

place_first.label: carry one coffee cup to the dining counter

place_second.label: carry the remaining coffee cup to the dining counter

select_left.label: pick up the coffee cup in the left dining placement zone

select_right.label: pick up the coffee cup in the right dining placement zone
